subject: Discovery recap + quick check on budget/priority
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@lucenthealth.com>, Sofia Rivera <sofia.rivera@lucenthealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-01T15:22:00Z
Subject: Discovery recap + proposed next steps

Hi Liam / Sofia —

Great to meet this afternoon. Quick recap from our discovery and proposed next steps so we all have the same checklist:

What we heard
- Pilot intent: validate inference latency and cost for Lucent's clinical summarization pipeline
- Scope: 500K tokens/day peak, 10–20 concurrent users, PII-sensitive PHI dataset (on-prem requirement for audit trail)
- Success metrics: per-call latency under 500ms p95, <30% uplift to current infra TCO

Proposed short plan
1) Technical validation (2 weeks): provide a lightweight on-prem deployment with sample model + synthetic data
2) Cost run: run representative workload and produce token-level cost estimates
3) Exec review: present findings and decision criteria for full rollout

Open questions / asks for Lucent
- Who owns procurement / budget sign-off? (name + title)
- Any specific security artifacts required beyond SOC 2 and audit logs? (e.g., specific KMS/HSM vendor)

Attachments: Lucent_MVP_MAP.xlsx (mutual action plan), redwood-onepager.pdf (product summary)

Next steps I suggest
- I’ll send a one-page pricing summary by EOD Wednesday.
- Can we tentatively aim for validation to start the week of Nov 15 if approvals look OK?

Thanks — happy to adjust based on your timeline.

Best,
Irene Choi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Liam / Sofia —

Per my note, attached a short pricing summary that maps to the pilot plan. Highlights:
- Pilot (2 weeks): est. $6k–$8k (env + short reserve for peak)
- Monthly run rate (if expanded): est. $4k–$6k based on batching and KV cache assumptions
- Cost levers we'll use: quantized model variant, prefix caching, and request-level routing

Please note these are preliminary — we'll run an exact figure against a representative trace during the validation.

Quick ask: who at Lucent signs off on pilots under $10k vs anything that needs committee review? If you can share the approver name/email I’ll include them on the mutual action plan.

Attachment: pricing-summary.xlsx (pricing table + assumptions)

Best,
Irene
